script_text: Aquarius, this week the cosmos flips your world sideways — and you'll love it. Early week, the Sun settles into Virgo in your 8th House, sharpening talks over shared money, debts, and intimacy. But Monday night, the Moon in your sign opposes Jupiter in your 7th House — a relationship decision looms. Your modern ruling planet, Uranus, blazes through Gemini in your 5th House of romance, delivering an electric, unexpected attraction midweek. Wednesday, the Moon enters Pisces and your money-focused 2nd House. Then Friday's Full Moon in Pisces illuminates it — a delayed payment or settlement finally lands. With Jupiter glowing in your 7th House, Sunday's commitment talk seals real romance. Friday is your power day because that Full Moon literally pays you. Monday is your toughest day — dodge ultimatums and drama. Breathe like true Fixed Air before signing anything this week. Follow for daily updates.
